_about: Declared seats for the status page. station = the machine the seat runs on. The watcher reads seats on its OWN station from their local checkout (repo folder + 'checkout' suffix, HANDOFF.md), and seats on other stations from origin (task file + last commit matching 'commits'). Add a seat here, no code change. Optional 'url': the seat's Claude session link (Remote Control sessions only); the card title links to it.
